title: Cleaner
description: Radical activists take 300 hostages at an energy company's annual gala in a high-rise building. It's now up to a former soldier who works as a window cleaner to save the hostages trapped inside, including her younger brother.

title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
description: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression.

title: Mom and Dad Save the World
description: The dastardly emperor (Jon Lovitz) of another planet beams up a station wagon with a California couple (Teri Garr, Jeffrey Jones) inside.

title: A Clockwork Orange
description: Young Alex (Malcolm McDowell) and his droogs commit barbaric acts in a near-future, dehumanizing society.

title: The Town
description: A Boston bank robber (Ben Affleck) looks for a way out of his criminal lifestyle after beginning a passionate romance with the woman (Rebecca Hall) that his gang briefly took hostage.

title: Carrie
description: A social misfit (Sissy Spacek) with psychic powers wreaks havoc at her prom to get even with pranksters.

title: The Apparition
description: A paranormal researcher (Tom Felton) must save a couple (Ashley Greene, Sebastian Stan) from a malevolent entity that feeds on fear and torments them no matter where they run.

title: The Blair Witch Project
description: A filmmaking crew (Heather Donahue, Michael C. Williams, Joshua Leonard) hikes into Maryland's Black Hills Forest seeking clues about a legendary witch.

title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
description: When a townie takes collegians on an overnight tour in Burkittsville, Md., they awake to chaos and have no memory of sleeping.

title: Blair Witch
description: A group of friends (James Allen McCune, Callie Hernandez, Corbin Reid) and their two guides encounter the legendary Blair Witch while exploring the Black Hills Forest in Maryland.

title: The Meg
description: A massive creature attacks a deep-sea submersible, leaving it disabled and trapping the crew at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean. With time running out, a rescue diver must now confront an unimaginable threat, a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark.

title: Meg 2: The Trench
description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

title: Red Riding Hood
description: A young woman (Amanda Seyfried) begins to suspect that the werewolf terrorizing her village is someone she loves.

title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
description: A journal is discovered written by Abraham Lincoln throughout his life that reveals from the time he was a young boy, Abraham Lincoln's life was intertwined with vampires.

title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman.

title: Charlie and the Chocolate Factory
description: A poor boy (Freddie Highmore) and four spoiled children win a tour through the incredible factory of an odd confectioner (Johnny Depp).

title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter
description: A journal is discovered written by Abraham Lincoln throughout his life that reveals from the time he was a young boy, Abraham Lincoln's life was intertwined with vampires.

title: Fantastic Planet
description: The 39-foot-tall pastel Draags keep leashes on the Oms, their tiny pets descended from humans.

title: Walkabout
description: A lost teenager (Jenny Agutter) and her little brother (Lucien John) meet an Aboriginal teen (David Gulpilil) in the Outback.

title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
description: Agent Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) comes to Twin Peaks, Wash., following two unresolved murders and the disappearance of two fellow agents.

title: Time Bandits
description: Cosmic dwarfs take a boy on an odyssey featuring Robin Hood (John Cleese), Napoleon, King Agamemnon (Sean Connery).

title: Hall Pass
description: Rick and Fred, two husbands who are having difficulty in their marriages, are given a Hall Pass by their wives for one week, they can do whatever they want.

title: Adult Best Friends
description: Katie takes her best friend on a nostalgic trip to their hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

title: Shazam!
description: Billy Batson is a streetwise 14-year-old who can magically transform into the adult superhero Shazam simply by shouting out one word. His newfound powers soon get put to the test when he squares off against the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana.

title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
description: When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives and the fate of the world.

title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
description: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

title: Broken City
description: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe).

title: The Art of Getting By
description: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).

title: Collision Course
description: A Japanese detective (Pat Morita) and a Detroit detective (Jay Leno) team up to recover a stolen top-secret turbocharger.

title: The Player
description: About 65 real-life movie stars fringe the satire of a Hollywood studio executive (Tim Robbins) who gets away with murder.

title: Night on Earth
description: Five brief encounters occur in five taxis on the same night in Los Angeles, New York, Rome, Paris and Helsinki.

title: The Man
description: A case of mistaken identity leaves an ATF agent (Samuel L. Jackson) squabbling with a talkative salesman (Eugene Levy) in his custody.

title: A Thousand Words
description: A fast-talking literary agent (Eddie Murphy) must learn how to live without speech upon discovering that he has only a thousand words left to say before he dies.

title: Masterminds
description: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.

title: Isle of Dogs
description: In the future, an outbreak of canine flu leads the mayor of a Japanese city to banish all dogs to an island that's a garbage dump. The outcasts must soon embark on an epic journey when a 12-year-old boy arrives on the island to find his beloved pet.

title: Contagion
description: The world panics as doctors race to find a cure for a rapidly spreading virus that kills those contaminated within days.

title: The Darkest Minds
description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. Betrayed by the adults in power, they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future.

title: The Transporter Refueled
description: Former special-operations mercenary Frank Martin (Ed Skrein) utilizes his covert skills when a femme fatale (Loan Chabanol) uses him as a pawn in her vengeful scheme against the human trafficker (Camille Delamarre) who victimized her years earlier.

title: Trap
description: A man and his teenage daughter realize they're at the center of a dark and sinister event while watching a concert.

title: Repo Men
description: Set in the future when artificial organs can be bought on credit, a man struggles to make the payments on a heart he has purchased. He must go on the run before the heart is repossessed.

title: The Mountain Between Us
description: Stranded on a mountain after a plane crash, two strangers must work together to survive the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles.

title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
description: When his boss (John Tormey) turns against him, a hit man (Forest Whitaker) who lives like a samurai must fend for his life.

title: Ricochet
description: An escaped hit man (John Lithgow) seeks revenge on the policeman turned district attorney (Denzel Washington) who sent him to prison.

title: A History of Violence
description: Vicious criminals continue to harass a man (Viggo Mortensen) and his wife (Maria Bello) after he thwarts a robbery attempt at his diner.

title: Chasing Mavericks
description: Hearing that the mythic Mavericks surf break is real, a teenage surfer (Jonny Weston) asks a local legend (Gerard Butler) to teach him how to ride the wave and live to tell the tale.

title: All Eyez on Me
description: The true and untold story of prolific rapper, actor, poet and activist Tupac Shakur (Demetrius Shipp Jr.), from his early days in New York to his status as one of the world's most recognized and influential voices.

title: Robin Hood
description: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.
